horizon_success_gate: B selected count model has lower equal-day count MAE than the pair-opportunity baseline and wins at least five of eight dates.
B logistic has lower equal-day Brier score than training prevalence and wins at least five of eight dates.
B has lower equal-day count MAE than A under the same selected model and wins at least five of eight dates.
route_success_gate: At least two of three horizons satisfy all horizon gates.
post_run_rule: Report every horizon and date. Do not retune, replace dates, add a second KBTP batch, or add a model family after seeing results.

reproduction_note.purpose: Replay the distributed snapshot; only dependency checksums are updated. Original protocol and results are retained. No model, data split, threshold or source-group choice is changed.
